caps: For 20 years, the world slowly fell apart.
By 2048, the world had split in two.
In the Pacific, China is surrounded.

bubs: Sir. Moscow and Beijing sent a message.
Pull back in 24 hours... or they launch.
If they launch, we launch EVERYTHING.
Russia and China: nuclear strike in 24 hours.

caps: Air Force One. Marine One. Mountain bunkers.
Everyone else needs a shelter too.
People fight over the last food.
Public shelters fill up in minutes.
Smoke rose high into the sky...
The surface is no longer livable.

bubs: Where's the rest of the food?!

caps: Most public shelters never make it.
Year 4. The first scouts go outside.
The north is still deadly. But the south...
Children are born who have never seen the sky.
Most bombs fell on the north.
Farms. Homes. Power. A new beginning.
Australia, Argentina and South Africa rebuild.
Ships connect them. Food flows again.
Every year, faster than the last.
